profile.headline: Software Developer - Paychex
profile.summary:
* Experienced IT professional with expertise in object-oriented programming, application and website development, business analytics, and technical documentation.

* Track record of solid performance as a member of a virtual worldwide team, developing and supporting global software solutions.

* Solid problem-solving skills that create both practical and agreeable software solutions.

* Excellent technical communication skills, including native fluency in Spanish.

* Talented public speaker, with experience as an actor on stage, television, and film.

* Experience and success in technical curriculum development and training.

Specialties: Application Development using C#, ASP.NET 4.0, AJAX, Java, JavaScript, ASP, C, Visual Basic, and UNIX shell scripts. Business Analytics using IBM Cognos BI 10 Report Studio.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for the ongoing development of a customer-facing, web-based application that tracks large fleets of trucks.  Designed and implemented several enhancements to this application using Visual Studio 2008 / ASP.NET 3.5 and Visual Studio 2010 / ASP.NET 4.0.

* Acquired experience developing Java applications using IntelliJ IDEA and Maven.

* Mentored and supervised an engineering intern student during his first professional engagement as a software developer.

positions.title: Systems Consultant
positions.description:
* Made several enhancements and improvements to an existing web-based order placement application for North American Breweries, using ASP.NET 3.5.  Designed and developed new web-based applications for LPA customers using ASP.NET 4.0.

* Wrote several Effort Estimation and Scope Of Work documents as part of pre-sales efforts to obtain new business for the company.

* Achieved IBM certification with IBM Cognos 10 Report Studio and experience with data modeling using IBM Cognos 10 Framework Manager.

* Performed quality assurance and data validation testing for several reporting applications developed using IBM Cognos.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
* Redesigned the user interface, access control, and business logic of a web-based customer relationship management system using ASP.NET.

* Developed a library of standard composite controls for use in a web-based Order Tracking application.

* Acquired experience using Oracle PL/SQL, writing stored procedures to interface with customer management databases.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
* Employed as a long term onsite consultant for Xerox Global Services.

* Contributed to the development of two enterprise-wide web-based applications for Xerox : a Service Portfolio Manager and a Billing Administration Tool.  Both applications utilize ASP.NET and LINQ to SQL to interface with Xerox’s corporate incident and billing databases.

* Acquired experience using CodeSmith templates for the quick regeneration of business tier classes whenever there was a change in the underlying database structure.

* Improved the performance of several aspects of the Billing Administration Tool by extensive refactoring of the code to reduce memory usage, and by using MS SQL Server Profiler to minimize database calls.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
* Developed customized web-based applications using ASP.NET and AJAX, with read/write interfaces to the Current Communications inventory, customer, and billing databases.

* Developed numerous incident ticket reports and accounting reports using SQL Server Reporting Services.

* Provided maintenance and development of the Current Communications billing system by creating and editing C# console applications and MS SQL server objects including database tables, stored procedures, SQL Jobs and DTS packages.

* Improved the operation of the Current Communications billing system by simplifying and optimizing existing source code, and eliminating redundancy by creating reusable classes and project assemblies.

positions.title: IT Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed web-based reporting applications using Java, JavaScript, ASP, Visual Basic, ODBC and JDBC.

* Provided ongoing development and web-based training courses for an internal MS Excel costing tool for the HP Managed Services division

* Authored and implemented technical documentation, and provided production support services, for HP’s worldwide call tracking system and knowledge management system.

* Administered a Sybase database of worldwide call tracking data, including creation of accounts, maintenance of tables and views, and a web-based reporting interface.
